dct_description_sm: The Atlantic Aboriginal Climate Change Adaptation Gathering (AACCAG) intended to provide adaptation planning support through different workshops for participants to share strategies and experiences in face of climate change and in dealing with emergency response to a changing environment. More specifically, the aim of the project was to: (1) introduce workshop participants to the adaptation side of climate change; (2) review potential impacts on Atlantic Aboriginal communities' infrastructure, and other possible implications; (3) develop adaptation response agendas for the Atlantic Aboriginal Community; (4) discuss ways communities can adapt; (5) and identify funding sources. The three-day workshop provided First Nations with technical and management specialists with opportunities for in-depth learning, and interaction on a variety of climate change/adaptation knowledge and strategies.
